newsitem.title: USA: Philly Fed's Trebing sees more moderate growth.
newsitem.headline: Philly Fed's Trebing sees more moderate growth.

text.p: Philadelphia Federal Reserve Bank economist Michael Trebing said he expected continued moderate growth in the regional manufacturing sector over the coming months,

"The forecasts of the these manufacturers are for some improvement over the next six months, but the readings that we have for last month and this month are that manufacturing activity has slowed," Trebing told reporters in a teleconference after the Fed bank released its monthly index of manufacturing activity.

Trebing added: "So the manufacturers, I guess, are not convinced that there will be any protracted decline in their business, but are fairly optimistic. I would suspect we're probably in line for continued moderate growth."
The Philly Fed said its index fell to -2.2 in December from 6.4 in November. Meanwhile, prices paid and received fell and rose to 13.9 and 6.2, respectively.
